sources.snippet: Qwen2.5-1.5B-Instruct is a 1.5-billion-parameter instruction-tuned language model from Alibaba's Qwen team. It is designed for efficient on-device or self-hosted deployment, supporting chat/conversational tasks with improvements in coding, math, instruction following, and structured output (JSON).
